name: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth
summary: A librarian seeks magical works for the library's collection. Your contribution can help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: Any magical work you find may earn a place on the library's shelves. Its collection grows through your efforts, and the librarian welcomes further discoveries.

faq.answer: The librarian asks you to bring magical works that could benefit the library's collection.
It comes from a librarian: Garion Wendell in Stormwind for the Alliance, or Owen Thadd in the Undercity for the Horde.
The librarian says the library's knowledge expands through your efforts.

attribution: In-game quest text: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth
